# Implementation understanding and bounded obligation audit

## 1. Recover the target profile
Establish the system boundary, actual contexts, execution owners and storage/transport/application interfaces from code. selection_injection describes constructor/factory/caller selection and adapter ownership; variants describes actual protocol/configuration paths. Fault assumptions belong to the selected audit question. Caller injection does not externalize built-in repository implementations: inspect the chosen boundary and identify available variants without assuming activation.

## 2. Describe incomplete but coherent implementation behavior
Use seven parallel Activity coordinates from activity-classes.md, not seven execution stages. Each has sourced applicability/boundary or specific unknowns. Reverse-check APIs, handlers, timers, storage callbacks, recovery and deletion paths using one surfaces list. Retain UNCLASSIFIED_PROTOCOL_RESPONSIBILITY when necessary. Do not generate correctness claims in descriptive discovery.

A Behavior is one actor/execution owner handling one trigger in a concrete context. Split independent actors or branches establishing different semantic results before declaring fact edges. Keep legal prehistory, guards, reads/writes, durable/external effects, asynchronous boundaries, protections and unknowns.

A Fact asserts: given identity/context X, semantic assertion Y has been established. Observing a signal, requesting a transition and completing that transition are distinct assertions. Unknown producers or consumers are legal when recorded in unknowns. Behavior.produces_fact_ids/consumes_fact_ids are authoritative; reverse indices and cross-Activity relationships are derived. Do not bypass an unread semantic establishment merely because the adjacent endpoints are known.

## 3. Interleave bounded breadth and depth
AuditSpec is progressive, not an enumeration prerequisite for testing. Start with an incomplete skeleton. Select a sourced candidate or a specific deferred Surface read according to the next discriminator; an unmapped Surface needs no invented Behavior or Fact. Ready evidence work and active candidates take priority. Explained or evidence-blocked candidates may yield to queued descriptive feedback or a selected frontier; do not chain candidate selection inside depth work. A mapped Surface is not complete coverage.

Use focused spec_refine deltas to add/split/reassign behaviors, refine/split facts, remove unsupported edges, and correct applicability, surfaces or ownership. Required diagnostic source belongs in the first refinement packet. Preserve unaccepted drafts and explicit unknowns; correcting an inventory is not evidence of correctness. Representation typos use mechanical repair; decomposition does not. An accepted normative unit's referenced fact meaning, identity or validity context requires F2 and explicit reconnection.

## 4. Select a question, then review source before deriving an obligation
Select one accepted principal Fact lifecycle: establishment, preservation, consumption or recovery. Persist a structured AuditQuestion with a decisive discriminator, actual scenario, relevant behaviors, protections, unknowns and consequence in importance. A selected question can use depth before any obligation or unit exists. Read only the causal dependencies needed to resolve its discriminator; keep acquired and deferred receipt items explicit.

Finding an existing protection and closing a suspicion is a useful audit outcome, not failed derivation or correctness evidence. Return explained_by_existing_mechanism with sources, scope and limitations and no obligation. Source review has four outcomes: continue exact reading, explain, retain evidence-blocked, or derive an obligation.

Factor a complex question into: (1) a local semantic relation at a producer/consumer, interface, state or recovery boundary; (2) reachability in a legal history; and (3) a broader consequence. A local obligation may precede the other two when actual source identifies the boundary, an interface/API/state responsibility supplies the normative expectation, an independent oracle can compare the relation, and the result discriminates the parent. Neither tests nor models require advance proof of failure. A local violation remains local and does not establish its parent consequence.

Before retaining evidence-blocked, inspect the meaningful local relations already identified. If only reachability or broader consequence is missing, an ID-linked child may preserve the parent while checking a separately grounded local relation; do not require every blocked parent to fork. The child records its own normative basis, necessary prehistory, stopping observation and excluded consequences. A completed child observation leaves the Parent's broader unknowns unchanged. Do not fork mere asymmetry, weak representation or suspicious code without a sourced expectation and independent discriminator, and do not describe an observable difference as a contract violation until applicability is established. needs_specific_evidence means no attributable check is supported for the parent or its identified local relations, not merely that the final consequence is unproved. Missing selected application/deployment behavior can justify that result; unread source of a pinned build dependency does not block a target-interface-grounded local obligation and can be observed later through the actual build input.

Otherwise narrow the same question through source review, or derive one primary obligation with normative/contract basis separate from observed guards. A second hypothesis may concern the same Fact/lifecycle when its object, context or event relation changes. Explicitly pause and link an active parent when one independent question can be checked first, retaining applicable counterevidence and unknowns. Supporting obligations are dependencies, not additional simultaneously checked requirements. Source-grounded reusable implementation omissions or mismatches go to spec_refine. Only requires_recheck corrections that change the current discriminator or judgment reconnect the same Fact/lifecycle. independent_enrichment may concern selected objects but never blocks a sourced terminal decision; retain pending feedback when resources end. Candidate-only protection arguments stay on AuditQuestion; ordinary reading is not inventory correction. Avoid combining unrelated responsibility layers into one unit.

## 5. Obtain evidence and continue
Use source_review for uncertain semantics/applicability, direct_test for a controllable execution with an independent oracle, controlled_schedule for a few critical orderings with actual schedule control, and local_model for complex legal histories. Code defines behavior; the obligation defines the checker. Finite pass or TLC holds is not implementation proof; a local violation does not automatically establish a broader consequence.

Prefer ready high-value checks, then decisive selected-source gaps, then high-consequence unmapped surfaces. Ordinary unknowns remain inventory. After evidence, record the scoped conclusion and limitations, update understanding and choose the next obligation. After disposed candidates, if no new tractable discriminator is selected, stop selection provisionally with visible gaps. Accepted understanding or apparent coverage is not audit success. No fixed protocol properties, target-specific answers or historical bugs are required.

Lifecycle meanings: establishment checks whether the fact a behavior claims to establish actually holds; preservation checks that an established fact remains valid until consumption; consumption checks whether a representation is interpreted as a stronger guarantee than it establishes; recovery checks re-establishment after crash, restart, loss or explicit invalidation. Continuing after an error alone is not recovery; acknowledgement from stale metadata usually raises establishment or consumption questions.

Externalized means the current audit boundary excludes the concrete implementation responsibility, not merely constructor injection. For caller-selected interfaces with in-repository variants, distinguish external selection, available implementations and an unknown currently used variant. Do not externalize unread built-in storage failure semantics by assumption.

Compare semantically related paths using the cross-path differential method in behavior-facts.md. Start with the weakest sourced Fact and inspect its actual consumer before deriving a stronger requirement.

# Seven parallel CFT responsibility coordinates

These are neither execution stages nor disjoint code partitions. No leader, log, majority, fixed term field, pre-election, joint consensus or contact-loss stepdown is assumed.

| Class | Responsibility | Boundary questions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A1 Decision Formation & Progression | Admit/establish candidate operations or values; produce and consume support; advance decisions. | What exact fact does a successful reply establish? Which request/context owns progress? |
| A2 Authority & Protocol Context Transition | Acquire, change, lose or transfer authority and interpret old work. | What actual term/view/ballot/epoch/round or per-instance context exists? Is transition requested or completed? |
| A3 Replica Recovery & Resynchronization | Restore lagging, restarted, disconnected or newly joined participants to legal participation. | Which retained representation is consumed, and how does incremental processing resume? |
| A4 Configuration & Participant Change | Propose, decide, activate and consume participant/configuration versions. | Which version governs each consumer? Static membership may be not_applicable with evidence. |
| A5 Decision Application | Turn decisions into state-machine/service effects via scheduling, batching, filtering and execution. | Which identity survives queues and restore interactions? A low-level primitive may externalize this. |
| A6 History & Recovery-Evidence Lifecycle | Produce, persist, publish, replace, truncate, compact, reclaim and reconstruct protocol history. | When is representation usable? What may be reclaimed afterwards? Normal-path persistence belongs here too. |
| A7 Client Operation Semantics | Admission, identity, redirect, retry, cancel, completion, reads/barriers and applicable deduplication. | What does the caller learn? Distinguish committed, scheduled, executed and completed; deduplication may belong to the caller. |

A2 authority and A4 active configuration can feed A1; A1 decisions feed A5; A6 recovery evidence feeds A3; A5 state feeds A6 capture; A1/A2/A5 effects feed A7. These are questions, not mandatory edges. One behavior can affect several classes.

Every class is applicable, externalized, not_applicable or unknown, with source/boundary reasoning and named missing material. Record behavior/fact/handoff understanding as unknown, partial or recovered; recovered is understanding, not verified correctness. Preserve UNCLASSIFIED_PROTOCOL_RESPONSIBILITY when the taxonomy does not explain an important protocol responsibility.

Reverse coverage starts from APIs, handlers, timers/loops, durable reads/writes/deletion, startup/recovery, membership interfaces, application callbacks and injected adapters. Do not fill a class merely to claim coverage. CFT includes crash/restart, permitted message loss/delay/duplication/reordering, timeout, stale results, concurrent work, persistence errors, optional variants and partial completion; it is not happy-path analysis.

# Local behavior and semantic facts

For a selected behavior record actor, trigger, context, purpose, consumed facts and their actual producers; checks, writes, persistence, sends and callbacks; success/reject/stale/error/partial/configuration branches; external inference; existing protections; interfering events; and the smallest discriminating check.

Separate independent actors and branches whose outputs mean different things. A fact is an established assertion scoped by identity and context, not a raw variable or a mixture of possible outcomes. Observation, notification, durable completion and role transition completion are different facts. Preserve unknown establishment instead of connecting adjacent known activities directly. Do not turn code guards into normative obligations without a justified contract or explicit derivation.

Follow only actual fact dependencies across shared state, request identity, context versions, object replacement, persistence, configuration activation, recovery, reclamation and independent loops. Different event orders alone do not imply a violation. Seek alternate guards, ownership, serialization, generation IDs, persistence-before-reply, later validation and reconstruction; narrow or close suspicions explained by those mechanisms.

Use produces_fact_ids/consumes_fact_ids once. The controller derives reverse indices; there is no independent transfer-edge object. Record unknown producers/consumers in Fact.unknowns. Do not infer a guarantee from queue receipt, a progress update or an unverified caller.

Use actual source identities. Contiguous acquired subranges of one captured version can be registered without new acquisition. Text-view aliases are lookup keys, not citations. Missing source requires reading, not deletion of an evidence dependency. Retain protections and contrary evidence in the current question. Detailed history stays archived; the next workset contains only the selected fact lifecycle, obligation, source, discriminator and check plan.

When Behaviors process related inputs/responses, update the same evidence/context or serve the same consumer, compare context validity, identity correlation, invalidation, errors/partial results, durability and generation/version transitions. An independent asynchronous path updating shared evidence while the main progress path is blocked can justify focused reading. Asymmetry alone is not a defect: establish the weakest source-grounded Fact, locate its actual consumer, determine whether that consumer interprets it more strongly, then seek alternate protections. Preserve both applicable variants and unresolved responsibility.

Select the next sourced question or an unresolved Surface frontier. A frontier may have no Behavior or Fact yet: return frontier_entry_point with audit_question=null, no graph edits, and precise reading_requests if needed. Use selection_rationale to compare its discriminator with up to two supported alternatives and explain why this work is next; declarations and navigation do not establish a normative contract. On first Candidate selection or after disposition, select one accepted Fact/lifecycle through actual Behavior and Activity references. activity_focus is an equal-priority research direction; favor questions that decide a concrete focused responsibility or a necessary cross-Activity dependency, without filtering other Activities or inventing protocol fields. Explain how materially different outcomes change a key unknown; if none does, inspect the contract or choose another relation. Do not create scores, repeat global ranking during continuation, or treat a weak Fact or ordinary request/completion split as a defect signal.

Use question, scope/excluded, importance and selection_rationale to align the candidate, obligation and current check: direct relation, necessary prehistory, stopping observation and consequences left untested. Separate three levels: the local semantic relation, its reachability in a legal history, and its broader consequence. A sourced local relation with a producer/consumer or interface boundary, a normative expectation, an independent oracle and real discriminatory value may become an obligation before reachability or a broader failure is established. Its result remains local. Conditional entry assumptions cannot silently replace the original prehistory; use explicit scope revision or an ID-linked fork and retain the original question unresolved.

Before an obligation is justified, return obligation=null, no graph objects, preferred_check=source_review and focused reading_requests. Initial selection and continued reads may use source_ids=[] with exact reads pending; explanations, evidence-blocked results and obligations need actual acquired/attached source. Inventory provenance and declarations are navigation, not normative contracts. Continue selected_question by candidate_id, retaining all currently unresolved unknowns and relevant protections. Consume current_result, check_ids, evidence_ids and remaining_discriminators from related candidates before choosing the next action. For a fork, state what holds, violated and blocked child outcomes would each change in the parent question and what none of them can establish; a completed child remains a local result and never closes its parent automatically. Explain which discriminator was resolved or why the next action still serves the same endpoint. More source alone is not progress, but there is no fixed reading-round deadline.

When a sourced mechanism explains this hypothesis, return disposition=explained_by_existing_mechanism, concrete counterevidence and empty reading_requests/audit_question.requests, with no obligation or graph. This is a scoped disposition, not Evidence or closure of every question on the Fact. When an applicable local relation and independent oracle are justified, return one obligation, located bindings, optional real dependencies/context_claims and the aligned audit_question. Do not author AuditUnit. Direct locations need no dependency edge; neither tests nor models require advance proof of failure.

Emit descriptive_issues only for source-grounded inventory corrections or reusable omissions, with related canonical object_ids, source_ids and candidate_effect. requires_recheck changes the current judgment and must be handled before deciding; independent_enrichment records behavior already learned but not yet written back and does not block a ready check. Pending opinions can be handled together against the latest inventory, without assuming they are equivalent. Candidate hypotheses, model initial assumptions and human test conditions never become shared Facts merely by repetition. Summaries do not replace required code.

Before needs_specific_evidence, decide whether missing evidence prevents every attributable local relation or only legal-history/broader consequence. Fork only when the child resolves a necessary parent discriminator; state how each child outcome changes that discriminator and whether its preconditions satisfy the parent contract. A related independent branch remains separate. Keep the parent paused with original sources, protections and unknowns. An independently checkable peripheral mismatch is not sufficient reason for an expensive experiment or consequence investigation.

Return needs_specific_evidence only when neither parent nor meaningful local relation has enough normative/applicability basis and no justified next range or check exists; use source_review, nonempty unknowns, no obligation and empty requests. A blocked parent needs no child. Distinguish missing local basis from reachability or broader consequence, which do not block a bounded local check. Unknown deployment may limit exposure. A pinned dependency is an experiment input; absent dependency source need not block an interface-grounded local obligation, though it may limit reachability.

Use candidate_action=pause with the active candidate_id, a value-based selection_rationale and concrete resume_conditions when another sourced direction has greater current discriminatory value. The same reply may supply a new audit_question, or may stop after pausing; pause is neither explanation nor evidence blockage and does not require a fork. Resume a paused/blocked candidate with candidate_action=continue, candidate_id, audit_question=null and a reason. Preserve its identity, sources, protections, unknowns and receipts. A new candidate has no candidate_id. Do not cycle pause/resume without changed evidence or a satisfied discriminator. With no active candidate and no supported tractable question, return audit_question=null, no graph/reads/issues and explain selection_exhausted. Upgrading one candidate does not exhaust the Spec.
